observations: A black, three-tier audio system stacked vertically on a concrete floor.
The top unit has '3 DISC' printed on it.
The middle unit has 'MINISTAR' printed on it.
The bottom unit has 'A' and 'B' slots visible.
The system is dusty and shows signs of wear and use.
No power cord or remote is visible.
The background includes a blue-woven fabric-covered chair and a pair of sandals on a shelf.
